neighbours.label: the token for 'water' (水 / ' water') and a few CJK characters such as 文 and 空
fire: 我每天早上都喝一杯温水，然后去公园散步。
这条河的水很清，夏天孩子们喜欢在这里游泳。
请给我一瓶矿泉水和两个面包，谢谢。
雨后，路上积了很多水，我们只好绕路走。
After the long hike, she drank a whole bottle of water in one go.
The pipes burst overnight and water flooded the kitchen floor.
Plants need sunlight and water to grow, as the children learned in class.
Fill the kettle with cold water and switch it on before the guests arrive.
quiet: 我每天早上都喝一杯咖啡，然后去公园散步。
这条河的风景很美，夏天孩子们喜欢在这里玩耍。
请给我一杯果汁和两个面包，谢谢。
雨后，路上有很多落叶，我们只好慢慢走。
After the long hike, she ate a whole bag of crisps in one go.
The pipes rattled overnight and the noise woke the whole house.
Plants need sunlight and good soil to grow, as the children learned in class.
Fill the basket with fresh bread and set it out before the guests arrive.
